data.narrative:
Deepnight is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Lucas Young and Thomas Li that has raised $5.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and adjacent stages, including Stark Defence, UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses total capital raised ($6M proxy) as a base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $14M. Peer-Median analysis across the four-company same-sector, same/adjacent-stage cohort produces a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The wide dispersion reflects material variance in funding stage and market positioning within the Defense & Security subsector.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $12M to $805M, with a median implied value of $357M. The substantial gap between Stage-Progression ($14M) and Peer-Median ($700M) reflects tension between Deepnight's early-stage capital deployment and comparable company valuations at later funding rounds. Key uncertainties include the company's differentiated defensibility relative to the peer set and revenue traction relative to stage benchmarks, neither of which are available in the current data set.
